name: Dress Code
overview: Scripture teaches that God calls His people to honor Him in all their ways, including their dress, recognizing that outward appearance reflects inner discretion and godly character. Deuteronomy 22:5 clearly forbids cross-dressing as an abomination to the Lord, emphasizing distinct roles and boundaries in attire. The Lord’s eyes are ever watchful over both good and evil (Proverbs 15:3), and believers are reminded that even lustful looks reveal the heart’s condition (Matthew 5:28). Thus, a proper dress code aligns with acknowledging God’s authority and living in obedience to His standards.
